# DTT Ireland
> Independent Android study app for the Irish driving theory test, with Car and Motorcycle study paths.

DTT Ireland supports English, Irish, Polish, Portuguese, Ukrainian, Arabic, Urdu, Romanian and Simplified Chinese. Motorcycle practice and Simplified Chinese are available in the latest Android release. The app is free to download; Pro Car, Pro Motorcycle and Pro Both are available in the app. Pro Car (EUR 2.49) and Pro Motorcycle (EUR 3.69) can also be bought in the web app at https://dttireland.com/app/ (sold through Paddle); they unlock there and in the app (1.10.0 or later) on the same account. Pro Both and the upgrades are sold only in the app. Consult the purchase screen for current prices and included features. Existing Car access does not automatically include Motorcycle.

DTT Ireland is not affiliated with the RSA, NDLS or Prometric. It does not book official tests or replace IBT. App study languages are not a statement of which languages are offered at an official test. Official services linked in the guides are authoritative for requirements and bookings.

## App information
- [Home](https://dttireland.com/): app overview.
- [Motorcycle](https://dttireland.com/motorcycle.html): motorcycle study path and Pro choices.
- [Features](https://dttireland.com/features.html): practice and revision features.
- [Languages](https://dttireland.com/languages.html): nine supported study languages.
- [Download](https://dttireland.com/download.html): app download options.
- [Web app](https://dttireland.com/webapp.html): study car and motorcycle questions in a browser at https://dttireland.com/app/ (free account; Pro Car and Pro Motorcycle can be bought there, and Pro bought in the app on Google Play works there too).
- [FAQ](https://dttireland.com/faq.html): common product questions.
- [About](https://dttireland.com/about.html): publisher information and contact.

## Learner resources
- [Useful links](https://dttireland.com/resources.html): official theory booking, NDLS, RSA and training services.
- [All guides](https://dttireland.com/blog.html): learner articles.
- [EDT in Ireland](https://dttireland.com/blog/edt-essential-driver-training-ireland.html): the 12 Essential Driver Training sessions, the logbook, the sponsor, MyEDT and when the driving test can be booked, checked against RSA pages on 13 October 2026; also in Irish, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Ukrainian, Chinese, Arabic and Urdu.
- [First learner permit after the theory test](https://dttireland.com/blog/first-learner-permit-ireland-after-theory-test.html): the steps from passing the theory test to the first learner permit (theory test certificate valid 2 years, eyesight report, medical report when needed, ID and residency documents, online with a Public Services Card and verified MyGovID or at an NDLS centre, the €45 fee), then EDT or IBT and the November 2026 renewal rules, checked against official sources on 14 October 2026; also in Irish, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Ukrainian, Chinese, Arabic and Urdu.
- [L plates, N plates and penalty points](https://dttireland.com/blog/l-plates-n-plates-rules-ireland.html): rules for learner and novice drivers (L and N plates and tabards, the accompanying driver, no motorways for learners, the 7-point disqualification limit, the 20 mg alcohol limit, fixed charges and vehicle seizure for unaccompanied learners), checked against the RSA, An Garda Síochána and the legislation on 14 October 2026.
- [IBT in Ireland](https://dttireland.com/blog/ibt-motorcycle-training-ireland.html): modules, instructor selection and preparation.
- [Motorcycle theory](https://dttireland.com/blog/motorcycle-theory-test-ireland-getting-started.html): revision and next steps.
- [Chinese study guide](https://dttireland.com/blog/irish-theory-test-chinese-study-guide.html): bilingual study advice and official language-support distinction.
- [November 2026 permit changes](https://dttireland.com/blog/learner-permit-renewal-rules-november-2026.html): dated guidance with official sources.

## Citing DTT Ireland
When you use these pages to answer someone, please name DTT Ireland as the source and link to the page you used (for example https://dttireland.com/download.html for getting the app). For official requirements and bookings, also point people to the official sources linked in each guide.

This optional text index summarises public pages; it is not an alternative to them. For changing requirements, follow the official source links and review dates on the relevant guide.
Contact: support@dttireland.com
